question: Can the agent learn how much to trust different general feature blocks, while keeping uncertainty and fit costs explicit?
nomination: Use the highest primary accuracy among actual compatible paired linear encoder trials from the ordinary unified run. All word, character, style, embedding and familiarity blocks stay available. The same block learner can operate on other sparse or dense multi-view features; it never uses a dataset, text or encoder name.
methods: Compare the ordinary pipeline to two variants of its block scales. The label-free variant shrinks towards equal block RMS energy. The supervised variant estimates how consistently each block's signed feature-label mean points in the same direction on two separate sets of connected fitting groups, normalizes by the RMS of cross-group inner products sampled without using labels, and shrinks the resulting kernel weights halfway towards uniform. Scores below zero get no evidence above the uniform floor. Deterministic seeds, grouping and bounds are frozen before outcomes. Count every supervised block-weight estimate as an extra supervised operation in addition to its classifier.
gates: On the common primary held fold compare each variant alone and as an equal vote against the two-member reference previously chosen on training feedback. Retain at most one best strictly positive choice for each variant, preferring simpler choices on ties. Require a positive confirmation_1 and pooled gain >=0.003, then lock the best eligible choice by worst-fold and pooled gain and test it once on confirmation_2. Require positive gain there before the new capability can enter a cold-run integration experiment.
resources: At most five base classifier fits, up to three additional supervised feature-weight estimates, zero paid language-model calls. Task labels are used only for fitting and for assigned held-fold comparisons. Released validation, H2 and formal test are sealed.
